property.name: CharacterName
property.formula: (select Character.Name FROM Character WHERE Character.Id = IdCharacter)

property.name: CharacterIsDead
property.formula: (select Character.IsDead FROM Character WHERE Character.Id = IdCharacter)

property.name: Skill
property.formula: (select Skill.Caption FROM Skill WHERE Skill.Id = IdSkill)

property.name: SkillLevel
property.formula: (select SkillLevel.Caption FROM SkillLevel WHERE SkillLevel.Id = IdSkillLevel)

property.name: SkillLevelBonus
property.formula: (select SkillLevel.Bonus FROM SkillLevel WHERE SkillLevel.Id = IdSkillLevel)
